item.title: Heffernan’s first EFL goal earns Harrogate valuable point against Cheltenham
item.description: Cathal Heffernan scored his first EFL goal as Harrogate Town continued their fight for safety with a hard‑earned draw against in‑form Cheltenham at The EnviroVent Stadium. The 20‑year‑old defender rose highest to nod home early in the second half, cancelling out Isaac Hutchinson’s opener and extending the Sulphurites’ unbeaten run to five matches. item.title: Sky Bet Championship Round Up: Coventry strike late to extend lead at the top
item.description: Jack Rudoni sent a record crowd at the CBS Arena wild with his 94th-minute strike in Coventry's 2-1 win over Stoke City. Frank Lampard's side had opened the scoring through talisman Haji Wright just 12 minutes in, the American's fifth goal in four games. The Potters levelled on the stroke of half-time through Ben Gibson's header.
